In this video, we will explore
the menu operations,
including the right-click context menu,

keyboard shortcuts, Command Status,
and the Status Bar.

Ensure the schematic
is the focused document.

Right mouse click within the design space
and observed the right-click menu.

Left-click in open space
to exit the menu pop-up.

Select a component
by left mouse clicking on it,

then perform a right mouse click
to observe the content of the right-click menu.

You will notice that the
right-click menu has changed.
Like all menus in Altium Designer,
the right-click menu is context sensitive

and will only show relevant commands
based on whatever object is selected.
If other objects are selected,

the right-click menu will change to reflect
the context of the selected object.

Now let's explore keyboard shortcuts
in Altium Designer.

Exploring the menu
along the top of the window
some letters are underlined.

These underline letters in the menu bar
are the shortcut keys for that menu.
For example, with the schematic in focus,

access the File menu directly
by pressing the ‘F’ key.

The File menu opens
at the location of the cursor.
Click in open space to close the menu.
Press the ‘T’ key to open the Tools menu.

Press the ‘C’ key to open
the Projects menu.

Observe that there are
further underlined letters
within these menu commands.

These represent another
keyboard shortcut.

Pressing the ‘F’ key
to open the File menu,

go ahead and press the ‘S’ key
to save the document.

When exploring and using
keyboard shortcuts,

search for the underline letter
within the menus

to discover the shortcut keys
to help expedite your work process.

Now we will explore the Command Status
and the Status Bar.
From the View menu,

locate the Command Status
and Status Bar entries.

If there are no checkmarks
to the left of these entries
left-click to enable these views.
The Command Status and Status Bar

are located
in the bottom left of the window.
Moving the cursor within the design space,

notice that the X and Y coordinates change
within the Status Bar.

The current grid size
is also shown in the Status Bar.

The bottom right corner of the Status Bar
has a Panel button

which allows us quick access
to our panels.

The Command Status
shows the active command.

Currently it is idle
as we do not have any commands active.

If we place a wire by selecting
Place, Wire
or using the keyboard shortcuts ‘P » W’.
Notice that the Command Status now shows
that we are in the Place Wire command.

Press the ‘Esc’ key or right-click
to exit the command.

Finally, in the top left corner
is the quick access bar.
This includes Save, Save all,
Undo, Redo,

and may also include folder options
as well.

In this video,
we explored the menu options,
right-click context menus,
keyboard shortcuts,
Command Status, and the Status Bar.

title: Altium Training - Design Environment: Menu Operations
